names_note: Expected fully qualified names derive from the historical original panel test prefix and the unchanged/added module mounts. A fresh native listing/JUnit must confirm them; no compiled listing or native result exists for this cohort.
frame_scope: Counts apply to one actual T readonly channel after fixture setup. The initial D and T command reads are separate closed setup peers. These tests do not establish the aggregate Root/Version/S/C 128-frame budget.
fixture_limits: Same-process fixed-purpose transport fixture, real SourceBound T handler and original owner/journal reads. Role credentials, Product declarations and B clock remain explicit fixtures. This bridge does not itself prove production four-connection admission or ordinary deployment.

cases.name: original_panel_training_proof_rejects_new_source_reentry_and_incomplete_slots
cases.behavior: A begun call cannot begin again or finish against another call. One panel is insufficient. A completed proof rejects a newly allocated Source even with the same call identity and same T bytes. An extra slot poisons the proof before another peer read.
cases.assertions: The actual private lifecycle helper runs while holding the original B mutex; partial panel uses 1 T, two complete-panel transactions use 2 T each. No B effect is dispatched and all upstream/B files stay identical.
cases.why_legacy_or_wrong_slot_cannot_pass: Individual fallback fails the same-call lifecycle expectations or performs original 8N reads, rather than the exact total 5; a canned fixture would leave actual-T trace at zero.

cases.name: original_panel_same_call_training_keeps_four_execute_and_three_readback_frames
cases.behavior: Known Missing performs one actual first read and does not renew a partial proof. The same finite channel then performs Execute4, Readback3 and Readback3; both reads return the identical original opaque B receipt.
cases.assertions: Trace milestones are 1, 5, 8, 11. Only the first actual Execute changes the B journal; later readbacks and all upstream files remain unchanged.
cases.why_legacy_or_wrong_slot_cannot_pass: N=2 Individual fallback costs 18/17 per Execute/Readback, so it cannot satisfy 4/3; old member peers cannot satisfy actual-T trace counts.

cases.name: original_panel_last_actual_training_failure_never_returns_or_resigns_b
cases.behavior: At actual readonly T request4, truncate only the same fixture native-training artifact before calling the original T handler. This is the final panel T slot, after the original receipt owner completed its two T checks and durable B effect.
cases.assertions: B Execute returns an error, B journal differs from before, a new Execute is ReadbackRequired, later Readback is CommitUncertain, the journal does not change again, and no fifth T request occurs.
cases.why_legacy_or_wrong_slot_cannot_pass: Trace4 plus three original Completed replies proves the failure was not the first panel read or either receipt-owner T read. The test deliberately permits an uncertain durable B signature and forbids return/re-sign.

cases.name: original_panel_last_training_slot_keeps_the_actual_cohort_tail
cases.behavior: Pause actual readonly T request4, withdraw the actual retention cohort target, then release the same request. The original T handler must still succeed and the later non-T physical tail must refuse the B response.
cases.assertions: Four actual requests and four original Completed responses exclude T transport failure as the reason. B is already durable; later readback remains fenced without more T requests or journal writes.
cases.why_legacy_or_wrong_slot_cannot_pass: If the last panel or its post-T cohort/Cell/qualification tail were omitted, this negative case would return B. The exact fourth-slot admission and 4/4 completed count distinguish it from an early failure.

cases.name: original_panel_cancel_keeps_the_held_lane_and_consumed_channel
cases.behavior: Pause first actual T, cancel only the async B waiter, observe Busy from a separate B consumer while the same original mutex remains held, then release. The original blocking exchange completes naturally on the taken channel.
cases.assertions: The canceled client stays Unavailable; the original work consumes 4 actual T. A fresh Execute is ReadbackRequired, and an allowed readback consumes 3 more for total7 while preserving the durable B journal.
cases.why_legacy_or_wrong_slot_cannot_pass: The fixture does not kill a Rust process or release the original owner lane. Actual Busy, consumed client, dispatch-once flag and 4 then7 frame counts detect cancellation reuse/fallback.

independent_review.finding: Confirmed actual consuming factory, Bound pin, real T replies, expected 5/11/4/4/7 requests and 5/11/3/4/7 Completed replies; no legacy/canned fallback found.
